moments.title: U2 Scores 12th UK Number 1 Album
moments.blurb: U2 have scored their 12th UK Number 1 album with 'Carnaval De Luz' (chart dated Nov 20-26), matching Bruce Springsteen's record for most chart-topping albums.

angles.name: Chart History
